appOverview: Fechas señaladas — the fourth Configuración screen. Master CRUD over key_dates, a single shared, global table holding the Canary Islands' official school calendar template (day/month only, no year): fechas clave FP, vacaciones, días festivos, días de libre disposición, evaluaciones and proyecto FEOE, each rendered as its own independent inline-edit table section, all following the same lib/patterns/crud-table-component.md shape Ciclos/Módulos already uses. Seeded once from documentation/calendario_dias_clave.json on every backend boot.

elementSpecs.behavior: Lists every key_dates row where category = 'academic_key_dates', inline-editable per lib/patterns/crud-table-component.md. No master/detail relationship with any other table on this screen — the six category tables are independent of each other.
businessRules: category is fixed for this table — never editable per-row (a row can't move between categories).
Deletion is always unconditional — nothing else in the schema references key_dates rows.
fecha (and fecha inicio/fecha fin, for range categories) must be a real day/month combination — client and server both validate (e.g. reject 31/02).
acceptanceCriteria: academic-key-dates-table shows an empty-state message when the "Fechas clave FP" category has no rows
academic-key-dates-table shows one row per key_dates row in the "Fechas clave FP" category, with columns: nombre, fecha inicio, fecha fin
Clicking academic-key-dates-table-add-button opens a blank, inline-editable draft row in academic-key-dates-table
Saving the draft row with a valid nombre and fecha (DD/MM) persists a new key_dates row via POST /api/key-dates and it appears in academic-key-dates-table
Saving with an invalid date (e.g. 31/02, or missing DD/MM format) shows an inline error and does not submit
Clicking a row's Editar switches it to inline-editable inputs for nombre, fecha inicio, fecha fin
Clicking a row's Eliminar deletes it via DELETE /api/key-dates/:id unconditionally (no confirmation, no dependency check) and it disappears from academic-key-dates-table
academic-key-dates-table displays a row's date as "DD/MM – DD/MM" when start and end differ, or a single "DD/MM" when they're equal

elementSpecs.behavior: Opens a blank draft row in academic-key-dates-table, pre-set to category 'academic_key_dates'.
businessRules: Always enabled — no precondition (unlike Módulos' add-button, which needs a selected ciclo).
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking academic-key-dates-table-add-button shows a draft row with blank nombre/fecha inputs in academic-key-dates-table

globalRules: key_dates is global/shared — not scoped per teacher, no FK to users, no FK to academic_years. Any signed-in teacher sees and edits the same six category lists.
Every date column stores day/month only (integers 1-31 / 1-12) — no year. This screen never shows or asks for a year.

A single-day entry (categories without a range) stores the same day/month in both the start and end columns internally — the UI shows and edits only one fecha field for those categories, never a redundant end-date field.
key_dates is seeded once from documentation/calendario_dias_clave.json (43 rows) automatically on every DATA_BACKEND=postgres backend boot, idempotently — not a manual import feature of this screen.
